# Bevory
> Bevory is a city-aware beverage discovery and local price guide for adults aged 25 and older in India. Bevory does not sell alcohol.

## Core pages
- [Local price guide](https://bevory.in/gurgaon): Browse products with approved local price records.
- [Categories](https://bevory.in/categories): Explore beverages by category and subcategory.
- [Brands](https://bevory.in/brands): Browse brand and product pages.
- [Bevory Guide](https://bevory.in/guide): Read beverage education, tasting and responsible-serving articles.
- [Party Planner](https://bevory.in/party-planner): Estimate drinks for a guest count and budget.

## Catalogue rules
- Product variants are shown only when a positive, available price exists for the selected city and the record is not awaiting review.
- Prices are informational and can differ from current retailer prices.
- Product and brand pages use stable canonical URLs; arbitrary search and sorting combinations are not indexable landing pages.
